title: Asian stock markets fall on weak US results
summary: The Nikkei plunges 1,033 points and drags down markets in Korea, Shanghai and Hong Kong, while investors remain cautious about the AI recovery.

title: Iran and Oman reach an agreement on the Strait of Hormuz route and gold rises 5%
summary: The agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz eases tensions, boosts gold and keeps US futures stable.

title: The Bank of England ends QT and bond markets pressure the Fed
summary: The BoE ends its quantitative tightening program, while bond markets question the Federal Reserve's policy.

title: Asian stock markets rise driven by Wall Street rally
summary: Asian markets are mostly higher, with the Nikkei, Topix and CSI 300 gaining ground following the Wall Street rally.
